name: Island Weaving of the World
subtitle: Lauhala, Bilum, Siapo & more
shortDescription: 7 Pacific weaving and bark-cloth crafts to play: Lauhala pandanus mat, Jaki-ed fine mat, Masi bark cloth stencil printing and Siapo painted bark cloth.
longDescription:
Island Weaving of the World: 7 Pacific weaving and bark-cloth crafts from 5 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Lauhala pandanus mat, Jaki-ed fine mat, Masi bark cloth stencil printing, Siapo painted bark cloth, Tivaevae appliqué quilt, Bilum looped string bag and Magimagi sennit cord.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can plait pandanus mats, print bark cloth, stitch quilts and loop bags, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
